what: T3a boxes (x0, x1, y0, y1 in % of width / height of the 1/8 cache, sensor orientation), placed by eye on the grid previews of t3a_inspect.py and the enlarged edge bands of t3a_zoom.py on 2026-10-23, before scripts/rebate_verify.py was first run; no base, CV or density value had been computed for these frames. rebate: unexposed film (gap between frames, edge between picture and sprocket row, film between sprocket holes); backlight: film-free light (inside a sprocket hole), only where it looked unsaturated; image_box: strictly inside the picture. A box was placed only where the film strip was clearly separable from the picture and from the holder at the preview size; no_rebate_reason records why not. A7R5 frames use the boxes of scripts/a7_measure.py and are not listed here. Same-capture copies (same camera model and capture time, different bytes) are handled in rebate_verify.py and have no entry.
placed_by: Claude (session of 2026-10-23), not yet checked by the research side or the user
